# SendUDPMsgTo

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SendUDPMsgTo:Void udp_stream:Int32, address:String, dest_port:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to send from. |
| `address` | In | String | required | The receiver's address or host name, as text. Brackets around an IPv6 address are allowed. |
| `dest_port` | In | Int32 | `0` | The receiver's port. Defaults to 0, which means the port of this stream. |

## Description

Sends what you wrote to the stream as one message to an address given as text, and empties the stream for the next one. It does what [SendUDPMsg](SendUDPMsg) does, but the address can be IPv6 and can be a host name.

## Differences

* Not in the original. The message is dropped if the address can not be found, or is an IPv6 address on a system without IPv6. See [IPv6](IPv6).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
a = CreateUDPStream(40762)
b = CreateUDPStream(40763)
UDPTimeouts 1000
WriteInt a, 12345
SendUDPMsgTo a, "127.0.0.1", 40763
Print RecvUDPMsg(b)
Print ReadInt(b)
CloseUDPStream a
CloseUDPStream b
```

```text
4
12345
```
